questions.help: Road traffic collisions             7 Obligations after a collisionAfter an accident, there are three times when the lives of the victims are in serious danger:The first moment occurs during the first seconds or minutes after the accident (immediate death).The second moment occurs during the first or second hour after the accident, when 75% of deaths usually occur. In this period, resuscitation and stabilization measures are of maximum benefit to the victims. This period is called the “olden hour”The last important moment occurs days or weeks after the accident (late mortality).(Página 257 del manual 'Learning to drive')
questions.question:
¿Qué porcentaje de mortalidad tiene lugar durante la llamada hora de oro?
How many deaths occur during the so-called golden hour?

answers.text:
Muerte inmediata, hora de oro y muerte tardía.
Immediate death, golden hour and late death.

Muerte inmediata, momento crítico y hora de oro.
Immediate death, critical moment and golden hour.

Momento de alarma, momento crítico y muerte tardía.
Alarm, critical moment and late death.
